nodes.text: Cover the ground with coarse gravel

Create a cold-blue unfinished concrete town on a broad square platform surrounded by rough rocky terrain. Arrange several dozen weathered gray masonry buildings, one to four stories tall, around a damaged central compound with exposed framework and debris. Keep the center cramped and irregular, with winding gaps and open yards, and thin the buildings toward the perimeter. Use flat roofs, barred windows, rusty doors, sparse balconies, and wall-mounted air conditioners. Place tall slender concrete towers among the buildings and across the surrounding terrain. Cover the ground with coarse gravel and exclude marked roads, pavements, vegetation, vehicles, and people. Use low harsh sunlight, long shadows, and a pale hazy sky.
